name: Jellyfin
author: Plinth
description: Who's streaming what from your Jellyfin server and the titles that just landed in the library — or a touch player that remote-controls a stream. Read from Jellyfin's own API, because the web app refuses to render inside a frame.

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.label: Jellyfin address
properties.help: The address you open Jellyfin on, including the port — typically http://<server>:8096. Use an https:// address if you have one: every poll sends the API key with the request, and over plain http that credential crosses your network in the clear.

properties.name: apiKey
properties.label: API key
properties.help: A Jellyfin API key: Administration → Dashboard → Advanced → API Keys → +. An API key carries server-wide rights — it can read every library and see every user's activity — so treat it like the server's password.

properties.name: view
properties.label: View
properties.help: Server overview lists every active stream plus the recently-added shelf. Player is a touch remote for one stream — art, progress, and pause/skip controls. Place two copies of the widget to have both.

properties.name: playerUser
properties.label: Player follows user
properties.help: Player view only: control the stream this Jellyfin user is playing. Leave blank to follow whichever stream was active most recently.
